mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a situation whereby a private entrepreneur funds a particular project for a public enterprise (e.g. a building) and is refunded later along with agreed interest."
Contactor financing is a situation whereby a private entrepreneur funds a particular project for a public enterprise (e.g. a building) and is refunded later along with agreed interest.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process whereby a public enterprise can plough back its profits for the purpose of expansion."
Self-financing is a process whereby a public enterprise can plough back its profits for the purpose of expansion.

The General Manager is the chief executive of public enterprises and therefore saddled with the responsibility of overseeing operations of the enterprises.

Performance contracts are used to define new relationships between public enterprises managers and the government with a view to making the achievement of desired results possible.

privatized public enterprises are those that the government considers strategic and wants to keep under its supervision through minority shareholding.
